newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor shares rise in u-turn on outlook.
newsitem.headline: Usinor shares rise in u-turn on outlook.

text.p: Shares in French steel producer Usinor-Sacilor did a u-turn and rose on the Paris bourse in afternoon trading as the market gave greater weight to the outlook than a fall in first-half profit, analysts said.
The stock was up 1.65 francs at 76.75 at 1305 GMT, after touching at high of 78.50, with more than 78,000 shares traded.
It had opened at a day's low of 70.50 francs after announcing a 65 percent plunge first-half profits to 833 million francs and warning of an even weaker second half.
Chairman Francis Mer said the first half of 1997 should be better than in 1996 and that the 1996 second-half results should be "clearly positive" even if weaker than the first half.
